correctness.rationale: Any Abelian-square factor of a weight-three binary word contains zero or exactly two ones; two-one factors use consecutive markers and have literal content 0^u1 0^g1 0^v with u+v+g even and |u-v|<=g. Summing checkerboard band gives H, and matching of the two pair families occurs only for b=c, yielding exact inclusion–exclusion. Summing gap extensions and parity projectors gives rational total series Z+2F−O. Uniform gap compositions scaled by n converge to Dirichlet(1,1,1,1); H/n^2 tends to half polygon area J, overlaps live on b=c with probability O(1/n), and beta integrals yield E[L]=1/40. Independent brute-force factor enumeration for all 7^4=2401 gap tuples a,b,c,d<=6 reproduced (1); aggregate T_0..T_11 = 1,4,21,54,124,234,423,702,1128,1706,2520,3580.
residual_risks: Finite cross-checks are corroboration, not universal proof.
